faq.q: What is the weather like in Marbella in May 2039?
faq.a: May 2039 in Marbella typically sees air temperatures averaging 24°C (highs 27°C) and sea temperatures around 22°C. Expect 10 hours of sunshine daily, with about 25mm of rain spread over 4 days. Winds are moderate: Levante (easterly) at 10–15 kts, Poniente (westerly) at 5–10 kts. Perfect for cruising.

faq.q: When is the best time of day for a boat charter in May?
faq.a: The best sailing window is between 10:00 and 16:00, when winds are typically lightest (under 10 kts) and the sea is calmest. Morning departures from Puerto Banús give you the smoothest ride, while afternoons can see a slight breeze, ideal for sailing. Evening charters are also pleasant, with sunset around 21:15.

faq.q: What should I wear on a boat in May in Marbella?
faq.a: Bring layers: a light jumper for the morning breeze, plus swimwear for the afternoon. The sun is strong (UV index 7), so use SPF 30+ and a hat. Sea temperature is 22°C, so a wetsuit or rash vest is comfortable for swimming. Don't forget a light waterproof jacket in case of a brief shower.

faq.q: Can I swim in the sea in May in Marbella?
faq.a: Yes, the sea temperature in May averages 22°C, which is refreshing but not cold. Most people find it comfortable for swimming, especially in the afternoon sun. If you're sensitive to cooler water, consider a short wetsuit. Our charters include snorkelling gear, so you can explore the clear waters near Cabopino or Cala del Faro.

Our skippers monitor conditions daily and will choose the best route, often hugging the coast for calmer waters.

Our skippers are trained to navigate around them, and we prioritise safety. If a charter is cancelled due to weather, you receive a full refund or reschedule at no extra cost.

data.body_html:
Planning a Marbella boat rental in May 2039? The weather is your deciding factor. With average air temperatures of 24°C, sea temps of 22°C, and 10 hours of daily sunshine, May is one of the best months for chartering. But it's not uniform: some days are perfect, others bring brief showers. This guide breaks down the forecast, the best sailing windows, and how to lock in your ideal day.

May 2039 Weather Overview for Marbella

Based on long-term climate data, May in Marbella typically sees:

  • Air temperature: 24°C average, highs up to 27°C
  • Sea temperature: 22°C, comfortable for swimming
  • Sunshine: 10 hours per day, UV index 7 (high)
  • Rainfall: 25mm over 4 days, usually short afternoon showers
  • Wind: Levante (E) 10–15 kts, Poniente (W) 5–10 kts

These figures are from historical averages, but for 2039 we expect similar patterns. The key is flexibility—our skippers monitor conditions in real time and adjust the route to maximise comfort.

Best Days for Charter in May 2039

While we can't predict exact dates months ahead, we can point to general patterns. The first half of May tends to be drier and calmer, with winds under 10 kts. The second half can bring more Levante days, which means a choppier sea but still manageable. For the smoothest ride, aim for:

  • Weekdays: Less boat traffic, calmer anchorages
  • Morning departures: 10:00–16:00 window, lightest winds
  • After a dry spell: Clearer skies, better visibility

Our [booking page](/) lets you check availability for specific dates, and we recommend reserving Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) early, as they're popular for small groups.

Typical Wind Patterns and Sea State

The Levante wind, blowing from the east, is the most common in May. It brings a light chop on the open sea, but our skippers know to hug the coast where the water is flatter. The Poniente, from the west, is lighter and often accompanies sunny, clear days. In May, expect wind speeds of 5–15 kts, which is ideal for sailing and motor cruising.

If you're sensitive to motion, choose a morning slot when the sea is glassy. Afternoons can see a breeze pick up, but our larger boats like the [Mangusta 80](/boats/mangusta-80/) handle it with ease.

What to Expect on Your Charter

All our charters from Puerto Banús include a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, and safety equipment. The Spanish IVA (21%) is always included in the price. For May, we recommend bringing:

  • Light layers for the morning breeze
  • SPF 30+ sunscreen and a hat
  • Swimwear and a towel
  • A light waterproof jacket for sudden showers

Our skippers will provide a safety briefing and suggest the best spots for swimming, such as Cala del Faro or Cabopino.

How Weather Affects Pricing and Booking

May is shoulder season, so prices are lower than in July and August. Our Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) are €749 for 2 hours, €2,299 for 8 hours. Tier B boats (Mangusta 80, including white and grey variants) start at €4,719 for a minimum of 4 hours, with a free jet ski included. Other boats, like the [Ferretti 94](/boats/ferretti-94/) or [Canados 86](/boats/canados-86/), are priced on request via WhatsApp.

If the weather looks unsettled, we offer free rescheduling up to 48 hours before departure. In the rare case of a cancellation due to weather, you receive a full refund. This flexibility makes booking early a safe bet.

Local Spots to Visit in May

With clear skies, May is perfect for exploring the coast. From Puerto Banús, head east to Cabopino (8 NM) for quiet coves, or west to Estepona (10 NM) for a lively marina. For a longer day, cruise to Sotogrande (20 NM) and anchor near the sandbanks. Cala del Faro and Cala Cortés are sheltered from the wind, ideal for swimming and snorkelling.

Our skippers know the best anchorages based on the day's weather, so you can relax and enjoy the views of La Concha mountain and the Golden Mile.

Why Book with Us for May 2039

We operate our own fleet from Puerto Banús, so you're not dealing with a middleman. Our skippers are local and know the waters intimately. With transparent pricing—no hidden extras—and a focus on safety, we make your charter seamless. Plus, our [fleet page](/) shows all available boats, from the compact Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) to the luxurious Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax).

Ready to secure your spot? Contact us via WhatsApp for a personalised quote, and we'll help you pick the best day based on the latest forecast.
